follow-up time: 50 days to resolve mass, 40 days for β-hCG concentrations to return to normal, and 61 days for menses to be restored
exposure: presence of a fetal heart beat
finding: Ultrasound-guided aspiration and curettage evacuation (UACE) followed by evacuation was effective for CSP, and subsequent mixed mass formation could be predicted by clinical and sonographic characteristics such as gestational sac diameter, fetal heartbeat presence, myometrial thickness, sac location, and Doppler signal grading.
